testcase.name: Scenario: Change the display of an applied custom command: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:73:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change the display of an applied custom command ✔ Given the ribbon customization dialog has an empty custom panel for "Part | 3D Model" ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel list ✔ And the user selects "Text" and leaves "Large" clear for the command ✔ And the user clicks "Apply" ✔ Then the "User Commands" panel shows a small command icon with "2D Sketches" beside it ✔ When the user selects "Large" for the same command ✔ And the user clicks "Apply" ✔ Then the panel shows a larger command icon with "2D Sketches" beneath it ✔ And the customization dialog remains open
